gene_liability.rationale: T1/T2: Tolerant to LoF (pLI=4.9e-7, LOEUF=0.845); Il1rl1-/- mice viable with impaired Th2/Treg tissue repair; high lung/adrenal/vascular TPM; peripheral anti-ST2 astegolimab well tolerated in Ph2/3 COPD/asthma, CNS sST2 vs ST2L untested
gene_liability.modulation_strategy: Isoform-selective sST2 neutralization or BBB-shuttled decoy blockade sparing Treg ST2L

gene_liability.tractability_flags: SM:Structure with Ligand; SM:High-Quality Ligand; SM:High-Quality Pocket; AB:GO CC high conf; AB:UniProt loc med conf; AB:UniProt SigP or TMHMM
gene_liability.rationale: T1/T2: Common human 24-bp exon-10 null duplication rs3831317 (AF=0.220, 40,441 homozygotes in gnomAD) benign & does not alter ALS susceptibility or survival; Chit1-/- mice viable with altered chitin/fungal clearance; OATD-01 Ph2 tolerated
gene_liability.modulation_strategy: No ALS causal rationale (human genetic LoF does not protect against ALS); genotype-adjusted CSF biomarker

gene_liability.tractability_flags: AB:Advanced Clinical; AB:GO CC high conf; AB:UniProt loc med conf; AB:UniProt SigP or TMHMM; PR:Database Ubiquitination; PR:Half-life Data
gene_liability.rationale: T1/T2: LoF tolerant in gnomAD (pLI=2.9e-29, LOEUF=1.509; human truncating alleles cause autosomal-recessive amyloidosis cutis dyschromica); PD 7p15 GWAS risk increases expression yet functional ALS/TDP-43 models show GPNMB is neuroprotective/pro-lysosomal
gene_liability.modulation_strategy: DO NOT INHIBIT in ALS (wrong therapeutic sign); utilize CSF GPNMB as DAM/lysosomal PD biomarker

gene_liability.modulation_strategy: Reclassify as reactive astroglial/white-matter CSF stage biomarker rather than Track B enzyme target
